items.meta_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2304.05332: Emergent autonomous scientific research capabilities of large language models
passages: In this paper, we present an Intelligent Agent system that combines multiple large language models for autonomous design, planning, and execution of scientific experiments.

Extreme scaling and reinforcement learning from human feedback have significantly improved the quality of generated text, enabling these models to perform various tasks and reason about their choices.
